description: This file is a shell script used for testing 'git apply' filename consistency checks. It defines test cases to verify behavior with patch files having various filename header issues.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success for the provided command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, used to verify error handling.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a specific pattern in output, used for validation.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of test cases.
